purpose: Descriptive analysis of empirical measured-protocol adult complete records and separately generated whole cohorts.

input.numeric_columns: real numeric dtype, not boolean or complex; canonical missing values only
input.sex_missing: None/pandas missing; literal NA conversion belongs to separate preparation

eligibility.unknown_sex_or_bad_numeric_schema: fail whole invocation; no silent coercion
eligibility.missing_or_ineligible_rows: exclude under this fixed rule and report overlapping reason counts
eligibility.age_boundary_origin: investigator-selected prospective use case, not an asserted paper cutoff

estimands.operator: Pearson correlation between TC and HDL residuals from the same common-row design

uncertainty.reference_slopes: HC3 sandwich, 1.959963984540054 normal multiplier; assumption-conditional sensitivity interval only
uncertainty.residual_correlation: unavailable; no Fisher/normal/bootstrap substitute in v0
uncertainty.degenerate_residuals: retain finite point slope where identifiable; interval unavailable

reference_outcome_sample_sd.role: evaluation-only metric denominator, never builder input

failures.constant_response: corresponding slope unavailable; residual correlation unavailable
failures.zero_numerical_residual_variation: residual correlation unavailable; corresponding HC3 unavailable
